Demo access and login

Demo access and login

The demo has no email allowlist. Login is membership-aware: existing users and provisioned members can sign in, and judges enter with an access code on /judge.

How demo login works

Magic links are issued to existing users and provisioned members — for example a speaker whose CFP submission was accepted. Unknown emails fail closed without enumerating other users: they cannot self-register on the demo host. There is no separate email allowlist to join.

Judge access

Competition judges open /judge and enter the access code from the submission. This mints a shared demo-persona session (admin, evaluator, or speaker) on the seeded demo event that lasts about four hours. The role switcher at the top of every shell moves between roles without re-entering the code and is badged “Shared demo”. Attempts are rate-limited (10 per 5 minutes per IP), the page 404s when judge access is disabled, and demo sessions mint API keys clamped to a 4-hour expiry (revoke limited to demo-created keys).

Get access as a real entrant

Submit the public CFP with your own email. When an admin accepts your submission you become a provisioned member, and membership-aware magic-link login gets you into the portal with that identity.

  1. Submit the public CFP with the email you will use to sign in.
  2. Wait for an accept decision (on the shared demo, an admin persona can record it).
  3. Open /login and request a magic link for that email.
  4. Complete the link and confirm your role chrome.

Role changes

If your role is upgraded to admin, request a fresh magic link so the session picks up new authorizations. Old sessions may not reflect mid-session role edits depending on implementation timing.

TIP. Public CFP submit needs no login at all. Only human login surfaces are membership-aware.

Where this lives in the app

  • /judge
  • /login

Open these routes on your demo or local host while you follow the steps above.
